en.dr-ali-peiravi: 2-127 Al-Khalil ibn Ahmad narrated that Ibn Mu’az quoted Al-Hussein al-Marvazy, on the authority of Abdullah, on the authority of (ibn) Oan, on the authority of Al-Hassan that God’s Prophet (MGB) said,

“God the Blessed the Sublime swore by His Honor and Grandeur that He would not give His servants (that is the people) two fears and two securities. If a person is not afraid of Me in this world, I will scare him on the Resurrection Day, and if he is afraid of Me in this world, I will make him secure on the Resurrection Day.”
